title: What is video as code?
music_prompt: calm minimal modern tech underscore, no vocals, loopable

beats.say: Recording and editing is the bottleneck. Re-takes, color, audio, and cleanup all add work. So I stopped recording. The script became the whole video, and the edit became a diff.
A beat keeps one complete thought together, even when it takes a few sentences. The visual can cut when its cue appears inside that paragraph.
Each complete thought gets one visual, cut to the exact word.
An AI voice reads it, free tools assemble it, and a finished video falls out.
No camera. No editor. Just a script you can change like code.
